property_summary: After initializing C via initialize() which sets royalties in CreatorRoyaltiesControl, calling acceptOwnership (which only changes owner) leaves royalties initialized; P's getRoyalties(0) returns the stored 500 bps config while M, missing the initialized check, also returns the stored config — this approach was already tried. Instead, we must find a scenario where the bug actually diverges. Since the mutant only removes the initialization check in getRoyalties, after deploy and before any initialize call, P reverts with NotInitialized while M returns the default config. We will use acceptOwnership merely as the entry point (it does nothing).
change_summary: Remove the check for initialized, so getRoyalties always returns the default config instead of reverting.
